message.field: The task kind, routed to the agent that handles it (plan|code|test|deploy|guard|research|reason|math|absorb|power|market|gremlin)
Name of the agent that handled it

transparency_contract.rule: Every agent_result with external claims must carry traceable sources in output (e.g. market results list only supplied evidence).
An agent that cannot do something returns ok=false with a clear error, never a fabricated success.
State-changing results (code/deploy) report rolled_back status so the UI can show the safety rail.
